candidates.excerpt: More than 50,000 nominations have been found valid for the Andhra Pradesh MPTC and ZPTC elections scheduled on November 3. Major parties including TDP, Jana Sena, BJP and YSRCP have fielded candidates across local body constituencies.

candidates.title: Kharge faces police complaint in Patna over controversial comment on Modi’s father
candidates.excerpt: A BJP leader has lodged a complaint against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge at Patna's Kotwali police station over his remark referring to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's father during a Congress event in Bihar.

candidates.title: From the French Revolution to Yellow Vests: Why protest is embedded in France’s political history amid nationwide unrest
candidates.excerpt: France’s latest unrest reflects a long history of mass mobilisation, from the 1789 French Revolution and the Paris Commune to May 1968 and the Yellow Vests movement. As protests over living costs and public services intensify, the streets remain a key arena for political dissent.

candidates.title: Spouses, Relatives Enter Fray In Local Body Polls
candidates.excerpt: Gollu Sarada is contesting the Rowthulapudi ZPTC seat on behalf of the YSRC, while her husband, Gollu Ramana Babu, is contesting the S. Pydipala MPTC seat.
